assessment: The first-party Tây Ninh land-environment portal exposes an official land-use planning map page for Thành phố Tây Ninh and names the provincial Land Registration Office as the map/data custodian. Direct retrieval from this environment failed during DNS resolution, and no public parcel API, current JavaScript configuration, schema/CRS, safe native ID, or geometry-only response could be inspected. The planning map should not be treated as an admitted cadastral parcel layer.

This supports registryFound=true under the packet rule, while leaving public vector access and cadastral completeness unverified.
